title: Moment of a uniform random sign
statement: Let $b$ be uniform on $\\{-1,1\}$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. Then $\\mathbb{E}[b^{k+1}]$ is $1$ if $k$ is odd and $0$ if $k$ is even.
